requirement:
Under `confirm`, a first `false` MUST finish the round for that subject. After
`true` or FIXME, the harness MUST obtain exactly one independent second assessment
of the same subject, with the same mandatory inputs and source state. Each
assessment may discover additional inputs and has its own usage record under
{cite}`requirements.authoring.usage_storage`.
rationale:
The tests cover each obligation in `requirements.authoring.confirmation`.

- **A first `false` finishes the round under `confirm`:** `src/authoring/mod.rs#fn[without_confirm_or_after_a_false_judgment_one_assessment_is_recorded]` runs `confirm` with a `false` first judgment. It asserts one provider request, one usage log, and that the recorded rationale is the first one. The non-confirm case in the same test checks that a `true` judgment gets a single assessment. `tests/authoring_cli.rs#fn[adaptive_routes_fresh_assessments_and_records_each_model]` shows the same for the CLI under the `once` policy.

- **A first `true` or FIXME gets exactly one second assessment:**
  - `src/authoring/mod.rs#fn[agreeing_assessments_record_the_first]` uses a FIXME first judgment. It asserts exactly 2 prompts and 2 usage logs, and that the recorded result is the first.
  - `src/authoring/mod.rs#fn[structural_assessments_and_confirmation_use_the_same_structural_contract]` uses a `true` first judgment and a `false` second. It asserts exactly 2 prompts.
  - `src/authoring/mod.rs#fn[citation_reviews_are_confirmed_with_fresh_targeted_conversations]` and `src/authoring/mod.rs#fn[disagreeing_citation_assessments_record_both_explanations]` cover the citation subject kind. The first asserts two usage logs. The second asserts exactly two prompts when the assessments disagree.
  - The CLI tests `tests/authoring_batch.rs#fn[confirm_runs_a_second_assessment_with_its_own_usage_record]` and `tests/authoring_batch.rs#fn[confirm_with_all_runs_a_second_assessment_for_each_batch_subject]` assert exactly two conversations per subject. `tests/authoring_batch.rs#fn[policy_comes_from_the_flag_then_the_configuration_then_defaults_to_confirm]` asserts the same count when `confirm` comes from the default.
  - The CLI tests also cover a second assessment after a `false` first from the adaptive mini model. That case makes two requests and not three.

- **The second assessment uses the same mandatory inputs and source state:** `agreeing_assessments_record_the_first` asserts `prompts[0] == prompts[1]`. The citation test asserts every prompt contains the same `Item under review`. The structural test asserts both prompts contain the same acknowledgment and subject text.

- **The second assessment is independent:** `citation_reviews_are_confirmed_with_fresh_targeted_conversations` asserts the third prompt, which is the second assessment's, does not contain the first rationale. `adaptive_routes_fresh_assessments_and_records_each_model` asserts each request has a single input item, so it starts a fresh conversation. It also asserts `MINI_ONLY_RATIONALE_SENTINEL` never reaches a later request.

- **Each assessment has its own usage record:** `agreeing_assessments_record_the_first` asserts two logs with distinct subjects, the second suffixed `(second assessment)`. The citation test asserts distinct `run_id`s. The CLI tests assert separate usage records for each subject.

- **Additional discovered inputs:** the text only permits them ("may"), so nothing needs checking.

Nothing the text requires is untested.

text: :::{req} confirmation
Under `confirm`, a first `false` MUST finish the round for that subject. After
`true` or FIXME, the harness MUST obtain exactly one independent second assessment
of the same subject, with the same mandatory inputs and source state. Each
assessment may discover additional inputs and has its own usage record under
{cite}`requirements.authoring.usage_storage`.
:::{req} usage_storage
Each assessment MUST have a separate JSON usage record under
`<state-root>/authoring/usage/<run-id>.json` using
{cite}`requirements.configuration.state_location`.
It MUST identify its format version, run, project root, subject kind and full
name, start time, backend and model when known, end time when finished, outcome,
accepted determination kind (`true`, `false`, or `FIXME`) when present, and
whether evidence was written. It MUST record the selected output destination in
`evidence_output` as `file` or `stdout`; a successful write to either destination
MUST set `evidence_written` to true. Usage recording MUST remain outside the
project in stdout mode. FIXME entry text MUST NOT be stored in usage records.
Failed, cancelled, or unfinished
runs MUST remain distinguishable from completed judgments. Records MUST persist
for later review without storing source text, prompts, responses, or rationale.
